createVault mints the CDP ERC721 to caller. Borrow, collateral withdrawal and destroyVault require exact ownerOf(vaultID)==msg.sender, not merely an approved NFT operator. Borrowed MAI and withdrawn collateral go to caller; destroyVault returns remaining collateral to the recorded owner and requires zero debt.

depositCollateral and repayments accept an existing vault without requiring caller ownership, spend caller tokens via allowance and do not grant ownership. Their onlyRouter guard permits direct users only while router==address(0); the explorer rendering observed zero, but owner can change it. No router/executor capability is admitted.

borrow/repay require an existing registered front-end vault ID with promoter in (0,10000]. _front is a fee-accounting ID, not calldata/executor. Source fees are converted into collateral and deducted from the borrower CDP, then credited to the front-end CDP. Opening fee is calculated on new total debt, not just newly borrowed amount; the collateral-ratio check precedes deduction of that opening fee. Insufficient collateral for fees reverts.

Borrow requires positive amount, funded MAI in the vault, current debt limits and sufficient oracle-valued collateral. Interest accrues with time and is capitalized on debt updates; repayment must leave either zero debt or at least minDebt. paybackTokenAll takes a timestamp deadline and transfers current accrued MAI debt; other selected CDP calls have no caller deadline/min-output/fee/rate guard.

Explorer rendering observed minimum collateral percentage=125, annual iR=1000 basis points, openingFee=closingFee=0, minDebt=10e18 and maxDebt=500000e18. These owner-mutable point-in-time values are not lasting financial terms or guaranteed available borrowing. Oracles, front-end configuration and debt parameters can change or cause reverts.

getPaid claims already-recorded maticDebt entitlement in cbBTC despite its MATIC-based variable name; getPaid(address) can be triggered by anyone but pays only that entitled address, never a caller-chosen redirection of another account’s claim. sourceSemantics.ownershipAndRecipients: createVault mints an ERC721 to msg.sender. borrowToken, withdrawCollateral and destroyVault require exact NFT owner, not approved operator. Borrow and withdrawal pay caller; destroyVault requires zero accrued debt then returns all remaining collateral to owner and burns NFT.
sourceSemantics.depositRepayGuard: depositCollateral, payBackToken and paybackTokenAll require existing vault and onlyRouter. onlyRouter means router==0 OR msg.sender==router, not an unconditional operator restriction. Snapshot router is zero; admin can replace. Deposits and repayment can fund a third-party vault without ownership and require caller token allowance to this exact vault.
sourceSemantics.frontEndId: borrow/repay _front must be an existing registered front-end vault ID with promoter>0 and <=10000. It selects collateral fee accounting, not execution target or arbitrary call bytes. Constructor creates NFT0 and registers front end0, but current registration is mutable and is not assumed perpetually valid.
sourceSemantics.borrowAndHealth: borrow requires amount>0, amount<=MAI balance held by vault, new debt<=maxDebt, total new debt>=minDebt and oracle-valued collateral ratio valid. Its opening fee uses newDebt (including existing debt), then reduces position collateral after the health check and credits front-end vault collateral. No user-set fee maximum or post-fee collateral-ratio assertion is introduced.
sourceSemantics.feesAndRounding: calculateFee floors through oracle-price, fee-BPS and promoter-BPS conversions and collateral decimal normalization. Opening/closing fees can be owner-set up to 500 BPS of the relevant debt quantity before promoter conversion; no current zero-fee promise. Repayment closing fee is calculated on amount repaid. Insufficient collateral for fee subtraction reverts.
sourceSemantics.interestDebtAndTiming: _vaultDebtAndFee computes floor(((iR*debt)*timeDelta)/ONE_YEAR)/10000; updateVaultDebt capitalizes accrued interest and refreshes timestamp when iR>0. payBackToken requires amount<=current debt and remaining debt==0 or >=minDebt. paybackTokenAll checks deadline>=block.timestamp and repays current accrued debt, not a stale quote. Other selected actions lack user deadline/rate/fee guards.
sourceSemantics.claimInterpretation: getPaid() transfers all nonzero maticDebt[msg.sender] collateral entitlement to caller after zeroing it. getPaid(address pay) does the same exclusively for pay and transfers to pay, so caller cannot redirect another account’s entitlement. Collateral is cbBTC here despite historical maticDebt name. Liquidation/acquisition calls and privileged withdrawInterest are not selected.
sourceSemantics.pausesAndEligibility: No explicit generic pause/KYC allowlist or asynchronous redemption queue in these selected CDP methods. Existing ownership/router/front-end, oracle and debt-limit checks remain authoritative; legal eligibility and frontend/jurisdiction restrictions are not attested.
